changes_vs_current: Scope: all-time professional golfers, men and women; influencer Paige Spiranac (pageviews #18) left out as an online personality rather than a tour golfer people name as a golfer. Strict averaging (missing = list length + 5) runs over three contemporary/active-only sources (YouGov contemporary, MC 2021) and three legend polls (Harris 2009, MC 2019, YouGov 2014), so it gave Tiger 1.83, Mickelson 4.33, McIlroy 5.67, Spieth 8.17, Scheffler 9.0, DeChambeau 9.33, Nicklaus 9.67, Daly 10.0, Koepka 10.17, Bubba 11.33, Palmer 11.83; legends were penalized by surveys that never asked about them. Gut-check moves: Nicklaus up to 2 (Harris #2, YouGov 2014 #1, MC 2019 #2, pageviews #5); Palmer up to 4 (MC 2019 #1 net favorability, Harris #3, pageviews #12); Scheffler kept above Spieth because his only low rank comes from the 2021 MC poll before his breakout (pageviews #3, YouGov fame 49%); Daly placed 7 because YouGov fame (54%, #4) and pageviews (#7) both rank him high and his only penalty is not being polled in MC 2021. Gary Player (pageviews #13) and Greg Norman (pageviews #21) are in the gut check and sit at 13-14; no source puts them lower than that. Hogan (gut check) stays at 23 because his only people source (pageviews #35) puts him low; critics break the tie in his favor over Annika and Lexi. Against the current list (9 kept, 15 changed): Tiger stays 1 and Nicklaus 2; Mickelson 10->3, McIlroy 19->5, Palmer 5->4 and Player 7->13. Bobby Jones 3->22 (Harris 2009 #5 but pageviews #32), Hogan 4->23, Faldo 18->24. Added from people data: Scheffler, Daly, DeChambeau, Spieth, Koepka, Bubba Watson, Fowler, Norman, Sergio Garcia, Dustin Johnson, Justin Thomas, Fleetwood, Rahm, Nelly Korda (pageviews #4) and Payne Stewart (pageviews #17). Dropped because no people source puts them in the top 24 (pageviews rank in brackets): Sam Snead (41), Seve Ballesteros (28), Tom Watson (36), Walter Hagen, Gene Sarazen, Lee Trevino (31), Mickey Wright, Annika Sorenstam (38), Byron Nelson, Kathy Whitworth, Old Tom Morris, Ernie Els (42), Vijay Singh (29), Nancy Lopez, Billy Casper.
confidence: Top 6 (Woods, Nicklaus, Mickelson, Palmer, McIlroy, Scheffler): high. At least 3 people sources each, and they agree with the gut check; the only open question is Nicklaus vs Mickelson for #2, where the legend polls are old (2009-2019). Ranks 7-12 (Daly, DeChambeau, Spieth, Koepka, Bubba, Fowler): medium. Each has YouGov fame or MC recognition plus pageviews, but they are close together, and fame figures of 45-54% make their order soft. Ranks 13-24: medium-low. Player, Norman, Stewart, Korda, Faldo and Hogan rest mostly on pageviews, and Bobby Jones on Harris 2009 plus pageviews. Pageviews carry news noise: Fuzzy Zoeller (344k), Shane Lowry and Paige Spiranac were near-misses with similar counts. Near-misses also include Annika Sorenstam, Lexi Thompson (YouGov fame 44%), Seve Ballesteros, Lee Trevino, Vijay Singh, Patrick Reed, Collin Morikawa and Xander Schauffele. Women are thin: only Korda made it, on pageviews alone. No Google Trends or TV-ratings data could be read, and Golf Digest/Harris golfer pages returned 403.
